De Circular Plastics NL (CPNL) subsidie: The Circular Plastics NL (CPNL) grant is available to organisations active in the plastics and recycling value chain. The total available budget is €40 million. Up to €1.5 million can be awarded per research project and up to €7.5 million per showcase project. Applications must be submitted by a consortium. The grant closes on 6 October 2026 at 17:00. When creating or updating a canonical page about CPNL, first check existing URL ownership and prevent possible cannibalisation.
